parameters.formDescription: Put last week on trial. See who left the most points on the bench, who set the sharpest lineup, and whether any manager literally benched a win.

parameters.content:
## How to use this workflow

Open the form, enter a public Sleeper league ID and a completed NFL week. Requests are logged to the **Sleeper Bench Court Requests** data table before live league data is fetched.

## What makes Bench Court different

The workflow solves a legal optimal lineup against the league's real starter slots—including flex and superflex—then compares it with actual scores, identifies benched wins, and renders a shareable weekly courtroom-style report.
